Update (October 7): Apple has made the two RC builds available for public beta testers to download. The build numbers are the same as the developer RC numbers.

In addition to seeding the second public beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is now also rolling out the first release candidates (RC) of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 to users. Here are the details.

Security updates continue to be provided for older macOS versions

As is customary with minor updates for older macOS versions, Apple has skipped seeding regular betas this time and has gone straight to the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2.

Apple seeded macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 at the end of last month, and both versions went through two RCs before being officially released.

In the release notes for the first RCs of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, Apple only mentions that the new versions "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's update included a security fix for CoreGraphics, with details as follows:

Apple is expected to disclose the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only after the official releases, which will most likely arrive in the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

The build number for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is 24H219, while the build number for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is 25G320.

Have you spotted anything new or different in today's RC build? Let us know in the comments.
